19:def bitstream_hash(filename:str)->int:
20:    """ Returns a hash of the bitstream """
21:    h = hashlib.sha1()
22:    with open(filename, 'rb') as file:
23:        chunk=0
24:        while chunk != b'':
25:            chunk = file.read(1024)
26:            h.update(chunk)
